plain_english: Now hear the secret final sacrament taught in the Śāmbhava teaching.
sanskrit_cite: atha śāmbhavaśāsanoditāṃ sarahasyāṃ śṛṇutāntyasaṃskriyām

plain_english: For all from lower stations up to gurus, clearly: after the aforesaid śaktipāta one should perform the funerary initiation.
sanskrit_cite: sarveṣāmadharasthānāṃ gurvantānāmapi sphuṭam | śaktipātātpurāproktātkuryādantyeṣṭidīkṣaṇam

plain_english: And for followers of the upper teaching whose selves are samaya-struck, the funerary initiation is to be performed by the tattva-knowing guru.
sanskrit_cite: ūrdhvaśāsanagānāṃ ca samayopahatātmanām | antyeṣṭidīkṣā kartavyā guruṇā tattvavedinā

plain_english: For him who stumbled through negligence into samaya-conduct faults, the funerary initiation is to be done — so in the venerable Dīkṣottara teaching.
sanskrit_cite: samayācāradoṣeṣu pramādātskhalitasya hi | antyeṣṭidīkṣā kāryeti śrīdīkṣottaraśāsane

plain_english: Whatever was told before in the rite called corpse-uplifting — that entire procedure here, on the corpse-body, he should perform, there on the image.
sanskrit_cite: yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ mṛtoddhārābhidhe vidhau | pratimāyāṃ tadevātra sarvaṃ śavatanau caret

plain_english: This rule told in the Siddhātantra is set forth: what would be last, making that last first and first last.
sanskrit_cite: śrīsiddhātantrakathito vidhireṣa nirūpyate | antimaṃ yadbhavetpūrvaṃ tatkṛtvāntimamādimam

plain_english: Having withdrawn each oblation, the funerary rite is held twofold — but not so for the sādhaka whose samaya is bathed in worship, meditation, and mantra.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtyaikaikamiṣṭiryā sāntyeṣṭirdvitayī matā | pūjādhyānajapāpluṣṭasamaye natu sādhake

plain_english: From the body's fall this one is freed, or becomes a sky-rover, dear lady; when the tattva-accomplished teacher has died, wherever it be.
sanskrit_cite: piṇḍapātādayaṃ muktaḥ khecaro vā bhavetpriye | ācārye tattvasaṃpanne yatra tatra mṛte sati

plain_english: No funerary rite at all is found for the pure-minded; but those killed by mantra-yoga rites are in hell — they.
sanskrit_cite: antyeṣṭirnaiva vidyeta śuddhacetasyamūrdhani | mantrayogādibhirye ca māritā narake tu te

plain_english: For them it is to be performed here by the ultra-compassionate guru; but no maṇḍala-etc. here — in the cremation-ground rite.
sanskrit_cite: kāryā teṣāmihāntyeṣṭirguruṇātikṛpālunā | na maṇḍalādikaṃ tvatra bhavecchamāśānike vidhau

plain_english: Some said even that is to be done in the mortuary: having worshipped the Omnipresent, he should perform the entire nyāsa as before.
sanskrit_cite: kecittadapi kartavyamūcire pretasadmani | pūjayitvā vibhuṃ sarvaṃ nyāsaṃ pūrvavadācaret

plain_english: By dissolution-sequence, from the foot to the head-end, just so should he awaken him — with rite, knowledge, and absorption.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhārakramayogena caraṇānmūrdhapaścimam | tathaiva bodhayedenaṃ kriyājñānasamādhibhiḥ

plain_english: With bindu he should block the tattva, with the śakti-seed pierce; at the nāda-place he should rub, and with the trident strike.
sanskrit_cite: bindunā rodhayettattvaṃ śaktibījena vedhayet | ghaṭṭayennādadeśe tu triśūlena tu tāḍayet

plain_english: With what lies inside suṣumnā indeed, with emission again and again he should strike all the kalās; then this bound soul trembles.
sanskrit_cite: suṣumnāntargatenaiva visargeṇa punaḥ punaḥ | tāḍayeta kalāḥ sarvāḥ kampate@sau tataḥ paśuḥ

plain_english: He should raise the left hand — or then join him to the Supreme; without proof, liberation is indeed unbelievable to the deluded.
sanskrit_cite: utkṣipedvāmahastaṃ vā tatastaṃ yojayetpare | pratyayena vinā mokṣo hyaśraddheyo vimohitaiḥ

plain_english: For this purpose this is taught — but not as giving what serves liberation; thus said the Supreme Lord in the venerable Kulagahvara teaching.
sanskrit_cite: tadarthametaduditaṃ natu mokṣopayogyadaḥ | ityūce parameśaḥ śrīkulagahvaraśāsane

plain_english: The to-be-proved, like liberation, is to be inferred through proofs, since beyond the senses; and in the Dīkṣottara the puryaṣṭaka-class offering is taught.
sanskrit_cite: sādhyo@numeyo mokṣādiḥ pratyayairyadatīndriyaḥ | dīkṣottare ca puryaṣṭavargārpaṇamihoditam

plain_english: Its rite: on the ear-petal lotus, in the middle the god Sadāśiva, the Īśa-Rudra-Hari-Brahman tetrad beginning with the east quarter.
sanskrit_cite: tadvidhiḥ śrutipatre@bje madhye devaṃ sadāśivam | īśarudraharibrahmacatuṣkaṃ prāgdigāditaḥ

plain_english: Having worshipped, hearing and touch, taste, smell, the twofold body, intellect and ego, and mind — to Brahmā and the rest he should offer in order.
sanskrit_cite: pūjayitvā śrutisparśau rasaṃ gandhaṃ vapurdvayam | dhyahaṃkṛtī manaśceti brahmādiṣvarpayetkramāt

plain_english: Having made their libation, with a hundred fire-offerings the guide effects this renunciate initiation, purifying the city-of-eight.
sanskrit_cite: eteṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā śatahomena daiśikaḥ | eṣā sāṃnyāsikī dīkṣā puryaṣṭakaviśodhanī

plain_english: And with the puryaṣṭaka gone, no heaven, hell, and the rest; having done thus, nothing worldly at all is to be done indeed.
sanskrit_cite: puryaṣṭakasyābhāve ca na svarganarakādayaḥ | tathā kṛtvā na kartavyaṃ laukikaṃ kiṃcanāpi hi

plain_english: Said in the venerable Mādhavakula: established in the teaching, even for the dead, he should abandon piṇḍa-offerings, water, tears — the worldly.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ śrīmādhavakule śāsanastho mṛteṣvapi | piṇḍapātodakāsrvādi laukikaṃ parivarjayet

plain_english: Having fully worshipped Śiva, he should perform the wheel-worship according to capacity, in order on the memorial days.
sanskrit_cite: śivaṃ saṃpūjya cakrārcāṃ yathāśakti samācaret | kramāttridaśamatriṃśatriṃśavatsaravāsare

plain_english: Thus told is this funerary sacrifice, spoken by the Supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: ityukto@ntyeṣṭiyāgo@yaṃ parameśvarabhāṣitaḥ
